title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode17 Dissolve Away

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: We were just talking about this video. It's hilarious...

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: Look, this part right here. Haha, isn't it incredibly...

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Everything okay, Mafuyu? Are you feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Oh, were you trying to make a joke?
I was just surprised because you never say things like that!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A joke? Oh, yeah.
It was a joke.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: Hahaha! That was a terrible joke, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh? What's my synthesizer doing out here?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I found this when I was cleaning your room earlier. I figured you didn't need a bunch of things you never use cluttering up the place.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I don't think I've seen you use it since your father bought it for you. I was going to throw it out tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Huh? You don't need it, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. A friend of mine introduced me to a tutor who specializes in helping students who are preparing to enter medical school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You have some free time next week, don't you? How would you like to meet with them? I thought we might hire a private tutor if you find someone you like.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I'm going to go to the store for a bit.
I'll be back in a while.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can give up now, can't I?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I haven't been able to find anything at all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've known my true feelings from the very beginning.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All I want is to disappear.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm glad I was able to find them.
Things will be better soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's alright to give up now, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I think Yuki just wasn't able to do that, though.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I bet she's been struggling alone for so long that she just reached her breaking point.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm going to make a song for Yuki. I want to save her.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If she wants to disappear, that's on her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Haha. OWN's music really is amazing, though.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It feels so cold and dangerous, as if it's rejecting anything and everything.
But if I can't find myself even then...then I'll just have to disappear.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yuki. I hate you, but I can't help but love your music.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you disappear, I won't be able to hear your music anymore, and that's...
